title: Rice/Paddy — Varieties, Nursery and Transplanting (Karnataka)
content:
RECOMMENDED RICE VARIETIES FOR KARNATAKA:
Kharif: Jyothi (115 days, popular), Sindhu, BPT-5204 (Sona Masuri), IR-64, Naveen, Intan.
Rabi: Jyothi, Kavya, Prasanna (Semidwarf, 125 days).
Hybrid varieties: KRH-2, PA-6444 (for irrigated conditions).

NURSERY PREPARATION:
- Seed rate for nursery: 25 kg seed/ha of main field.
- Nursery area: 500-600 m2 for transplanting 1 ha.
- Seed treatment: Bavistin (Carbendazim) 1g/L soak 24h. OR Trichoderma viride 4g/kg seed.
- Primed seeds: Soak in 1% KNO3 for 12h — improves germination.
- Seedling age for transplanting: 20-25 days (Short duration), 25-30 days (Medium duration).

TRANSPLANTING METHODS:
- SRI (System of Rice Intensification): 25×25 cm spacing, 10-12 day seedlings, 1 seedling/hill. Reduces seed rate to 5-7 kg/ha.
- Conventional: 20×15 cm spacing, 25-30 day seedlings, 2-3 seedlings/hill.
- Random: 3-4 seedlings/hill in flooded field.

DIRECT SEEDING:
- Seed rate: 40-50 kg/ha (wet direct seeding) or 30-40 kg/ha (dry seeding).
- Advantages: Saves labor, avoids transplanting shock.
- Requires good weed management in early stages.

SEASON:
- Kharif (Bhadra): June-July transplanting in Karnataka.
- Rabi (Yele): November-December transplanting (irrigated).

LAND PREPARATION:
- 2-3 plowings in puddled condition.
- Level field properly for uniform water distribution.
- Apply FYM 10 t/ha at last plowing.
